Hon'ble Shree Prakash Singh,J.
Heard Sri Ravindra Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Sushil Kumar Pandey, learned A.G.A. for the State, Sri Anil Kumar Tiwari, learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 and perused the record.

By means of the instant application, the applicant has prayed for quashing the impugned criminal proceedings in Special Session Trial No.618 of 2019, State of U.P. Vs. Virendra Kumar, arising out of Case Crime No.73 of 2018 under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 POCSO Act & Section 3(ii) (v) SC/ST Act, Police Station Chanda, District Sultanpur which is pending in the court of Special Judge POCSO Act/Additional Session Judge, Room No.1, Sultanpur.

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in the instant case.

He further added that an F.I.R. was lodged against present applicant under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 POCSO Act & Section 3 (ii) (v)

sentences.text: He added that as per the medical report, age of the victim at the time of incident was 20 years and as per the academic record, her age was about 16 years.
He added that the applicant and alleged victim performed marriage and there is a child from their wedlock.
Later on the parties sat together and they have settled their dispute and that too has been reduced in writing as a compromise deed dated 2.5.2022.

He submits that now the parties have put their all disputes at rest by way of executing compromise deed and thus further criminal proceedings against the present applicant would be a futile exercise and amount to harassment of the applicant.

Adding his arguments, he also submits that this Hon'ble Court vide order dated 21.4.2022 has referred the matter for compromise verification and in compliance of the aforesaid order, both the parties appeared before the court below and the compromise deed dated 2.5.2022 has been verified in presence of the victim, complainant and the applicant.

He next added that now the matter has been finally settled between the parties, and as such the proceedings ofSpecial Session Trial No.618 of 2019, State of U.P. Vs. Virendra Kumar, arising out of Case Crime No.73 of 2018 under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 POCSO Act & Section 3(ii) (v) SC/ST Act, Police Station Chanda, District Sultanpur, may be quashed.

sentences.text:
In support of his contentions, he has also placed reliance on the judgment rendered in Vishwas Bhandari v. State of Punjab and another reported in (2021) 2 Supreme Court Cases 605, Criminal Appeal No.105 of 2021, dated 03.02.2021 and has placed reliance on paragraphs 9 and 10 which are extracted hereunder:-
"9.

entities.text: Vishwas Bhandari v. State of Punjab and another reported in (2021) 2 Supreme Court Cases 605
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: We find that the evidence of the prosecutrix and the complainant before the Court shows that there is no allegation whatsoever against the appellant.
The main allegation was against Vikram Roop Rai but the prosecutrix married him on 4.8.2013 and had given birth to two children from that wedlock.
In the absence of any allegation against the appellant, we find that the continuation of proceedings against him is nothing but an abuse of process of law.
10. Since there is no evidence against the appellant, the proceedings initiated against him on the basis of FIR would be untenable.
The High Court was, thus, not justified in dismissing the petition against the appellant."
Referring the aforesaid, he submits that the case of the present applicant is squarely covered with the ratio of the Judgment aforesaid.

On the other hand, learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 has also supported the version of the applicant and submits that the parties have entered into compromise deed and now there is no dispute in between the parties and thus the criminal proceeding against the applicant may be dropped.
Learned AGA appearing for the State has no objection to the contentions aforesaid.

Considering the aforesaid submissions of the learned counsel for the parties, I find that compromise has been entered into between the parties on 2.5.2022 and said compromise has been verified on 5.5.2022 and, now, as per the statement of learned counsel for the parties, they do not want to press the aforementioned criminal case.

In view of the above, as the applicant and opposite party no. 2 have entered into compromise on 2.5.2022 and no grievance remains to be agitated and as such, further criminal proceedings in the aforementioned criminal case are liable to be set aside in view of the Judgement of the Apex Court rendered inVishwas Bhandari (supra).
Resultantly, proceedings of Special Session Trial No.618 of 2019, State of U.P. Vs. Virendra Kumar,
arising out of Case Crime No.73 of 2018 under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 POCSO Act & Section 3(ii) (v) SC/ST Act, Police Station Chanda, District Sultanpur, are hereby quashed.
